We’re looking for a VIP Monetization Manager to join our team in a specialized role focused on Loyalty Feature, aiming to enhance the experience of our games’ most valuable players.
By developing a retention-focused strategy tailored to this key player segment, you’ll drive efforts to strengthen the connection between our games and their high-tier player base, creating an impactful and lasting bond.
In this role, you’ll manage the life cycle of top-tier players, elevating their in-game experience through innovative mechanics and features—driven by data, testing, and evaluation. You’ll work closely with Monetization, Product, and Analytics teams, making data-informed decisions on priorities for both the game team and VIP Account Managers to support the long-term growth of our high-value player tiers. This position offers high-impact potential and a unique blend of creative and analytical skills for the right candidate.

Key responsibilities:
  • Leverage strong numerical and data analysis skills to drive business-oriented decisions, supported by insightful reporting and trend analysis
  • Analyze information effectively, drawing actionable conclusions to optimize player engagement and retention strategies
  • Collaborate with multiple interfaces across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to influence outcomes and align goals
  • Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented approach—able to tackle ch
SciPlay.title: VIP Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer with strong product thinking and a passion for developer experience. In this role, you will design, build, and evolve internal platform capabilities that support game development teams, working across infrastructure, backend services, and tooling. You will collaborate with multiple teams to identify friction points, improve workflows, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions.
This position requires a hands-on engineer who can balance quick wins with long-term improvements, take ownership, and drive impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, build, and maintain internal developer platform capabilities (CI/CD, environments, observability, infrastructure).
  • Identify and resolve developer pain points through data, feedback, and hands-on investigation.
  • Develop shared services, tools, and components to improve development speed and quality.
  • Promote engineering excellence, including reliability, automation, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and drive improvements.
  • Own operational aspects of systems, including monitoring, SLIs/SLOs, and on-call participation.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and long-term platform strategy.


Requirements:
  • 5–10+ years of software engineering experience (platform, infrastructure, or DevOps focus).</
SciPlay.title: Senior Platform Engineer

SciPlay.description:
The Assistant Controller will play a key role in supporting the Finance team across a broad range of accounting, reporting, and operational activities for the US and Israeli business units, collaborating closely with the accounting team to identify opportunities for process improvements and enhance efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly detail-oriented and proactive in supporting the team.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and record monthly journal entries for general ledger posting and perform related account reconciliations 
  • Assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, working closely with the Finance leadership team
  • Maintain the general ledger accounts for the respective legal entities, reporting discrepancies, imbalances, and other issues to the corporate finance team
  • Work with both internal and external auditors during the annual audit process, preparing the necessary supporting workpapers and schedules
  • Serve as the main point of contact for business owners to ensure accurate and timely invoicing through Oracle modules
  • Ensure compliance with internal control frameworks and regulatory requirements, with the support of Corporate Finance</
SciPlay.title: Assistant Controller

The VP Monetization serves as the studio’s senior monetization advisor and subject matter expert, partnering closely with game leadership teams to maximize business performance and player value. This role provides strategic guidance, data-driven insights, industry expertise, and monetization best practices to help solve complex business challenges and identify growth opportunities across the portfolio

Key Responsibilities:
  •  Serve as the studio’s subject matter expert on monetization, providing strategic guidance and thought leadership across multiple games and products.
  • Partner with game leadership teams to identify monetization opportunities, diagnose complex business challenges, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Support product, economy, and LiveOps teams in evaluating monetization strategies, pricing approaches, player segmentation, and offer design.
  • Leverage analytics, experimentation results, player behavior insights, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
  • Identify cross-portfolio monetization best practices and drive knowledge sharing across game teams.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and monitor industry trends to uncover new opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Influence decision-making through expertise
SciPlay.title: VP Monetization

SciPlay.description:
The VP Product role is a strategic product leadership position focused on supporting and aligning roadmap direction across multiple teams and product domains within the studio organization. The role partners closely with product leaders, game teams, and business stakeholders to ensure product initiatives align with company goals, player needs, and long-term business strategy.

This position focuses on shaping product strategy, driving roadmap alignment across multiple teams, and partnering with studio leadership to support long-term business growth and player experience. The role works cross-functionally with product, LiveOps, monetization, and development teams to help guide strategic priorities, evaluate opportunities, and ensure product initiatives align with overall business objectives.

Key responsibilities :

  • Driving strategic alignment across product roadmaps and initiatives
  • Supporting prioritization and investment decisions based on business impact and player value
  • Partnering with studio and product leadership to shape long-term product direction
  • Using data and performance insights to guide roadmap recommendations and feature strategy
  • Facilitating cross-team collaboration and organizational alignment
  • Influencing decision-making across multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment
  • The role requires strong business acumen, strategic thinking, communication skills, and the ability to influence
SciPlay.title: VP Product

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a talented and a Monetization Manager to join our team.
The Monetization team is responsible for driving revenue growth and providing the best game experience to our users. To achieve company business goals, the team constantly optimizes the game experience and performance based on data.
As part of your role, you'll manage a full-cycle campaign calendar, including planning short & long-term activities, defining goals, executing, and analyzing performance. Possess a deep understanding of existing game mechanics and how to best utilize them within Monetization tools.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop quarterly, monthly, and weekly promotional plans according to the monetization strategy
  • In charge of the implementation of promotions through the campaign design and creative creation in all communication channels
  • Responsible for the operational launch of campaigns, QA, monitoring results, reacting accordingly, analyzing the campaigns, and bringing insights for optimization
  • Leverage product features and marketing tools for driving revenue growth and providing a good game experience to our players
  • Constantly coming up with exciting new innovative ideas.
  • Constantly improving and optimizing in a data-driven manner the game experience and performance in order to hit the company KPIs.
  • Collaborate with the creative team, operations team, game economy team, BA, and product manage
SciPlay.title: Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
The Head of Monetization & Economy is responsible for driving the business optimization, monetization models, and game economy strategy across the studio’s portfolio—featuring one live product and two upcoming games in the pre-scale phase. This role is a unique blend of highly analytical business strategy and a deep commitment to the player experience. You will be hands-on in crafting the game economy, while managing and leading the LiveOps and monetization operations functions. By collaborating closely with Product, Creative, and LiveOps teams, you will champion out-of-the-box thinking and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to deliver sustainable growth, compelling in-game campaigns, and an unforgettable player journey.
Key Responsibilities
  • Business & Monetization Strategy: Drive the commercial success of our games by optimizing business models, monetization strategies, and revenue streams, ensuring a balance between high profitability and excellent player retention.
  • Hands-on Economy Design: Take a deeply hands-on approach to building, balancing, and optimizing the game economy and math models. Design the delicate balance of difficulty curves versus reward systems to maximize engagement.
  • Player Experience & Product Collaboration: Share the burden of the overall player experience. Collaborate closely with the Product department to spec features that support monetization, shap
SciPlay.title: Head of monetization and Economy

SciPlay.description:
As a Monetization 2D Artist at SciPlay, you will work closely with various stakeholders to translate each game’s message into visual realms.

You will collaborate with various SciPlay departments and teams to create stunning visuals within a fast-paced environment and while ensuring that they’re aligned with the SciPlay brand.

Key Responsibility:

  • Conceptualize, present and execute your ideas from A to Z: Lead your own creation
  • Work closely with Art Lead, and LiveOps managers to create amazing designs
  • Create a playful, intuitive cohesive look & feel, and overall user experience for our products
  • Prioritize work within a dynamic environment and while meeting tight schedules
  • Create functional and aesthetic briefs, adapt to different art styles, and maintain consistency with the overall game


Requirements:

  • 3 years experience in the gaming industry - Must
  • Understanding of the fundamentals of composition, form, colors, light, and shadow
  • Experience in Adobe graphic programs, with an emphasis on Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Full proficiency in various AI tools, prompt writing, and technical orientation.
  • Strong understanding of typography
  • Ability to create accurate concept sketches
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of UX/UI principles
  • Conceptual thinking and storytelling abilities
  • Strong accuracy and attention to detail
